title: Australian Duck Stew
description: A slow-cooked, luxurious duck stew inspired by Indian cuisine, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck leg until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the duck leg from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions, garlic, and ginger paste until fragrant.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, scraping the bottom of the pot to release the browned bits.
Return the duck leg to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Stir in the coconut milk and simmer over low heat until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
